prompt: When parking facing uphill along a curbed street, how must the front wheels be positioned for safety?

options.text: Turned sharply toward the curb so the front tire rests flush against edge
Turned sharply away from the curb so the rear edge rolls into curb if rolling
Straightened parallel to the roadway lane with parking brake disengaged
Turned left or right at random provided the manual gear shifter is in park
